## Objective
- Finish the existing Blocklands game as a complete, playable 3D first-person voxel sandbox with mobile controls.

## Requirements
- Build request; do not ask clarifying questions. Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- User repeated: “Continue where you left off and finish the game.”

## Decisions
- Kept the existing Italian-language, mobile-first sandbox and its procedural 50×50 world.
- Added jump controls for keyboard and touch, and cleared trees from the immediate spawn view for better visibility.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed malformed pointer-move logic in `game.js` that prevented the game module from parsing.
- Added touch jump button and Space-key jump handling.
- Expanded the initial tree-free spawn radius to improve the opening view.
- Added an inline empty favicon to prevent the browser’s favicon 404.
- Validated with `node --check game.js` and browser reload; latest browser console showed zero errors and warnings.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Briefly report the finished game, controls, and assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: World generation, rendering, movement, mining, block placement, inventory, and controls.

content.text:
Blocklands is finished and playable. It includes a procedural 50×50 voxel world, block mining and placement, an inventory, and keyboard and touch controls.

**Controls:** WASD to move, mouse or touch-drag to look, click/tap to mine or use the on-screen buttons, number keys 1–6 to select blocks, and Space or the jump button to jump.

I kept the existing Italian, mobile-first creative-sandbox design, with no survival mode or win condition. Validation passed: `game.js` parses, and the browser run showed no console errors.
